text:
Valentina (vendor ops): FYI BuenServ S.A. (AR) sent invoice and asked Redwood to gross-up for local VAT/perceptions. They want a single payment so they receive the agreed net.
Ravi (finance): Do we have a gross-up clause in the supplier agreement? I don't recall one.
Marco (acct exec): Contract is silent. Vendor claims Argentine withholding/perception will be applied if payment originates from outside AR (they provided CUIT 30-71234567-9).
TaxBot: High-level: Argentina can apply IVA/perceptions and certain withholdings on services. Need CUIT verification and proof of payment routing. Gross-up is a commercial ask, not a tax requirement unless in contract.
Valentina (vendor ops): They attached an AFIP constancia (constancia_cuit.pdf) and a note from their tax advisor claiming 15% "retencion" applies to non-resident payments.
Lucia (tax): Key items we need: 1) confirm paying entity (Redwood US / NL / AR) 2) AFIP constancia CUIT 3) any SIRCREB certificates or local withholding invoices.
Diego (payments): Policy: DO NOT GROSS-UP without tax/legal sign-off. I'll place payment on hold: "ARG WHT/GROSS-UP DISPUTE".
Marco (acct exec): Customer pushing month-end. Can offer provisional payment net and true-up later? Risky.
Ravi (finance): Prefer vendor reissue: either (A) grossed-up invoice showing calculation OR (B) accept net payment and provide documentation to claim credit locally. Otherwise we withhold per AR guidance.
Valentina (vendor ops): Asked vendor to reissue with a gross-up line or confirm they'll accept a withholding certificate. Also requested bank/payment instruction to prove payer entity.
TaxBot: Tip: ask vendor for AFIP payment receipt exemplar and to confirm whether the service is deemed performed in Argentina (place-of-supply). Save all docs to tax_evidence/2024/ar_buenserv_30-71234567-9.
Lucia (tax): If payment will originate from REDWOOD EUROPE (NL) and AFIP treats it as outbound to non-resident, withholdings/perceptions may apply. We won't gross-up unless legal signs off on a one-time amendment.
Diego (payments): Holding. Flagging AR ledger: "HOLD - WHT/ARG" and ticket created #AR-22001.
Marco (acct exec): Vendor replied: they can't reissue gross invoices due to ERP limits but can sign a one-time amendment accepting gross payment.
Ravi (finance): Legal + tax need that signed amendment. Lucia, can you draft required wording?
Lucia (tax): Will draft a short clause: vendor acknowledges gross-up amount, payer entity, and that they accept new total. Also require AFIP constancia and bank routing.
Valentina (vendor ops): Sent draft to vendor. They asked if we can instead withhold and provide a retencion certificate.
Diego (payments): If vendor accepts withholding, we can pay net and issue the retencion voucher. That is cleaner from a controls perspective.
Marco (acct exec): I'll offer withholding + retention voucher unless vendor signs amendment.
TaxBot: Reminder: keep copies of retention vouchers and bank instruction for audit.
Lucia (tax): Closing: hold payment until vendor signs amendment OR confirms withholding acceptance and provides missing docs. I'll review their AFIP constancia and advisor memo when provided. :white_check_mark:
